Class LedCanvas

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.api.led.LedCanvas
public final class LedCanvas extends Object
A 12x8 pixel buffer for the UNO R4 WiFi's built-in LED matrix, plus the shape and text drawing operations that paint into it. Callers create one boolean[HEIGHT][WIDTH] frame with new boolean[LedCanvas.HEIGHT][LedCanvas.WIDTH], draw into it with the methods below, and send it to the hardware with show(boolean[][]).

      public static void drawChar(boolean[][] frame, int asciiCode, int originX, int originY)
      Draws the printable ASCII character with the given code (32 space .. 126 '~'), using LedMatrixFontAscii. Reach for drawDigit(boolean[][], int, int, int)/drawLetter(boolean[][], int, int, int) instead when a program only ever prints digits and/or uppercase letters, to avoid linking in the full ASCII table.

    • drawSmallDigit

      public static void drawSmallDigit(boolean[][] frame, int digit, int originX, int originY)

    • drawDecimal

      public static void drawDecimal(boolean[][] frame, int wholeDigit, int fractionDigit, int originX, int originY)
      Draws a one-decimal-digit reading such as "2.5" (wholeDigit = 2, fractionDigit = 5): a small digit, a decimal point, and another small digit, laid out left to right from originX. The group is 9 columns wide (3 + 1 gap + 1 point + 1 gap + 3), leaving 3 of the matrix's 12 columns free to center it, e.g. originX = 1.
